_: Lessons cut from the practice workbooks (Levels 1 and 2 of the app). Each entry: the app's lesson number (its identity, never its position), the workbook section it is cut from (a section id as printed in the master's Table of Contents), the sheet the author records and edits, and the words the home page shows. A section = the pages it spans; a lesson section = one workbook page = one sitting. Run: node scripts/make-workbook-lessons.mjs [numbers]

21.title: Tanween

22.title: Natural Madd

23.title: Shadda
